outcomeNote: A bare mishnaic ruling in the same reciprocal form as the previous mishna; no dialectic and no second party.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כָּשֵׁר בַּפָּרָה – פָּסוּל בָּעֶגְלָה, כָּשֵׁר בָּעֶגְלָה – פָּסוּל בַּפָּרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» That which is «fit in» a red «heifer» is «unfit in a heifer» whose neck is broken; that which is «fit in a heifer» whose neck is broken is «unfit in» a red «heifer.»

moves.summary: The mishna states the reciprocal disqualification between the red heifer and the heifer whose neck is broken.
